entries.title: Package priority
entries.text: Package priority today: one, destroy the SA-6 battery at the Gori bridge (target area Bravo). Two, armour moving south on the main supply route. Three, logistics trucks at the Khashuri depot.
entries.say: Package priority: one, the SA-6 battery at the Gori bridge. Two, armour on the main supply route. Three, the trucks at the Khashuri depot.

entries.title: Rules of engagement, sector Bravo
entries.text: Sector Bravo is weapons free on positively identified armour and air defence. Weapons hold on anything inside the town of Gori. Friendly patrols are north of the river.
entries.say: Sector Bravo: weapons free on identified armour and air defence. Weapons hold inside Gori town. Friendlies north of the river.

entries.title: Rules of engagement, sector Charlie
entries.text: Sector Charlie is weapons hold. Return fire only.

entries.title: Threats
entries.text: Expected threats: one SA-6 battery at Gori, Shilkas with the armour column, MANPADS reported in the hills west of the main supply route. No enemy fighters expected; a pair of Mi-24s is possible.

entries.title: Frequencies
entries.text: Package common: 251.0 UHF. JTAC Axeman: 30.5 FM. Overlord: 264.0 UHF. Tower Senaki: 132.0 VHF.

entries.title: FARP and divert
entries.text: FARP Hammer is 12 kilometres south of Gori at waypoint 5. Divert: Kutaisi.

entries.title: Laser codes
entries.text: Package laser code 1688. JTAC Axeman lases on 1511.
